The '''skizzard''' was a creature found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. Skizzards were sometimes featured in the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Xexto/Legends|Xextos']] mosaic [[Artist/Legends|artwork]] that were designed to evoke feelings of speed and motion.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Skizzards were mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' expansion [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
